name: instants
title: Instants
description: Search and play sound clips from MyInstants.com directly from Raycast
author: 0xdhrv

commands.name: search-instants
commands.title: Search Instants
commands.description: Search for sound clips on MyInstants

commands.name: favorites
commands.title: Favorite Instants
commands.description: View and play your favorite sounds

commands.name: play-favorite
commands.title: Play Favorite
commands.description: Play a favorite by number (1-based). Supports deep link URL with arguments.

preferences.name: cacheDurationMinutes
preferences.title: Cache Duration (minutes)
preferences.description: How long to cache search and trending results. Default: 60.

preferences.name: downloadWhenFavorite
preferences.title: Favorites
preferences.label: Download when adding to favorites
preferences.description: Download the sound file to your device when you add it to favorites. Playback will use the local file when available.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
